words.zh: n. 简短的警句；短语，词组；习语；措辞，乐句；  v. 措辞；将(乐曲)分成乐句
words.example: Can you explain the meaning of this phrase in your own words?

words.zh: v. 劝说；说服；使相信
words.example: The teacher tried to persuade us to join the science club.

words.zh: v. 改变；调换；交换；转移；按下开关；转换；开关；开或关（电器）；【化】转变；  n. 开关；改变；转向；转换器；转换；【物】开关
words.example: The switch on the wall controls the classroom lights.

words.zh: v. 改变；调换；交换；转移；按下开关；转换；开关；开或关（电器）；【化】转变；  n. 开关；改变；转向；转换器；转换；【物】开关
words.example: Remember to switch off the lights before you switch on the projector.

words.zh: adj. 遥远的；远方的；疏远的；心不在焉的；不亲近的；久远的
words.example: The telescope can observe distant galaxies that are millions of light-years away.

words.zh: adj. 安全的；稳固的，可靠的；有把握的，确切的；安心的；  v. 使安全；保护；（经过努力）获得；确保；拴牢
words.example: We need to secure the equipment to the table before the experiment.

words.zh: n. 球形把手，旋钮，圆形突出物；  v. 突出；使有球形突出物；在…上生疖（长瘤）；给（门等）装球形捏手
words.example: Turn the knob clockwise to increase the volume of the speaker.

words.zh: n. 家用电器，器具；装置；应用，适用
words.example: This modern kitchen appliance saves both time and energy.

words.zh: n. 遥控器；  adj. 遥远的；偏远的；关系远的；冷漠的，冷淡的；远程的；微乎其微的；久远的
words.example: She used the remote to change the channel from the sofa.

words.zh: phr. 遥控，遥控装置，遥控操作；遥控器
words.example: The TV remote control was lying on the coffee table.

words.zh: n. 空调，空调设备
words.example: Our school installed a new air conditioner in every classroom.

words.zh: adj. 无意识的；自动的；自发的；  n. 自动手枪；自动工具
words.example: The automatic doors opened as soon as I approached the library.

words.zh: adj. 综合的，完整的，互相协调的
words.example: The new curriculum offers an integrated approach to science and art.

words.zh: v. （使）成为一体，（使）合并；完整，健全；（使）加入，融入群体；【计】集成；  adj. 完整的，组合的
words.example: Schools should integrate technology into daily teaching to improve learning.

words.zh: n. 传感器；敏感元件；探测器
words.example: The motion sensor in the hallway turns on the lights automatically.

words.zh: adj. 效率高的；有能力的；能胜任的；有功效的；【计】高效
words.example: Using solar panels is an efficient way to reduce energy costs.

words.zh: n. 模式；方式；风格；【数】众数
words.example: The phone has a special mode that saves battery power overnight.

words.zh: n. 常规；正常顺序；例行公事；一套固定舞步（或动作）；惯例，习惯；【计】例程；  adj. 例行的，惯例的；普通的；常规的，日常的，例行公事的
words.example: My morning routine includes exercise, breakfast, and a quick review of lessons.

words.zh: n. 每天的例行公事；日常工作；日常生活
words.example: Writing down my daily routine helps me stay organized and focused.

words.zh: n. 偏爱，喜好；优先（权）；【财】优先（权），偏袒
words.example: Her preference for classical music surprised her classmates.

words.zh: n. 瞬间；片刻；  adj. 立即的；即食的；紧急的；速溶的
words.example: He felt an instant sense of relief when the test ended.

words.zh: v. 命令；掌管，控制；值得，博得；指挥，统率；俯瞰；  n. 指令；命令；控制；掌握
words.example: Please give the robot a voice command to start cleaning.

words.zh: v. 服从，听从，遵守；【法】遵守，遵照；【化】遵循，遵守；【航】遵守
words.example: All students are expected to obey the school safety rules.

words.zh: n. 警告；预兆；预告；警示；警告（又作caution, book）；  adj. 警告的；警告；警示；引以为戒的；  v. 警告（warn的现在分词）
words.example: The severe weather warning urged everyone to stay indoors.

words.zh: n. 常数，恒量；常量；持久不变，始终如一；【计】常量；【化】常量，常数；【数】常数；  adj. 不变的；持续不断的；重复的；始终如一的；经常的；永恒的
words.example: The constant noise from the construction site disturbed our classes.

words.zh: phr. 早先；前不久；在初期
words.example: We realized early on that the experiment needed more time.

words.zh: adj. 反常的；畸形的；不正常的
words.example: The doctor found no abnormal cells in the latest test results.

words.zh: adj. 批评性的；文艺评论的；爱挑剔的；危急的；重要的；严重的；关键的，决定性的；临界的；【化】临界的
words.example: Clean water is critical for the health of every community.

words.zh: n. 癌症；（迅速蔓延的）恶劣的或危险的事物；毒瘤
words.example: Regular exercise and healthy eating can help prevent cancer.

words.zh: adv. 潜在地；可能地
words.example: This new technology could potentially change the way we learn.

words.zh: n. 潜力，潜能；可能性；  adj. 潜在的，可能的
words.example: Every student has the potential to succeed in their own way.

words.zh: v. 漏；泄露；渗漏；透露；【化】泄漏，渗漏；  n. 漏洞；泄漏，裂缝；透露
words.example: The pipe began to leak, so we called a repair worker.

words.zh: adj. 电的；电气科学的；用电的
words.example: Never touch electrical outlets with wet hands in the lab.

words.zh: n. 电线线路；布线；线路系统；  v. 动词wire的现在分词形式
words.example: The old wiring in the building must be replaced for safety.

words.zh: v. 拍电报；接通电源；给…装电线；将……连接到；  n. 电线，电缆，导线，金属丝，金属线；【物】导线
words.example: The technician used a thin wire to connect the two devices.

words.zh: v. 查明；【财】检测；【化】检测，测定；  vt. 探测；察觉；发现
words.example: Sensors can detect small changes in temperature and humidity.

words.zh: adj. 相关的，有关的；正确的，适宜的；贴切的；有意义的；切题的；【法】相关的，有关的；【化】相关的
words.example: Please include only relevant information in your science project report.

words.zh: phr. 着火，失火
words.example: Paper can catch fire easily if it is near a hot lamp.

words.zh: n. 幻想，想象；幻想作品；奇幻小说；  v. 奏幻想曲；想象；幻想；  adj. 虚幻的
words.example: Her fantasy about living on Mars inspired her science fiction essay.

words.zh: n. 创新，革新；新事物，新方法；创造
words.example: The new battery technology is a major innovation in renewable energy.

words.zh: adj. 可获得的，可用的；有空的；可找到的；单身的；  phr. 可用的，可得到的，有空的
words.example: The school library has many online resources available to students.

words.zh: phr. 从这种意义上来讲
words.example: Technology, in this sense, can make our future more convenient.

words.zh: adv. 然而，不过；尽管如此
words.example: The task was challenging; nevertheless, we finished it on time.

words.zh: v. 赋予……结构，使形成结构；  vt. 精心组织；系统安排；建筑，建造；  n. 结构；构造；建筑物；体系；组织；【化】结构
words.example: The structure of the essay should include an introduction, a body, and a conclusion.

words.zh: n. 安全；保护措施；债券；抵押物；安全工作；保障，保护；安检处；有价证券；安保部门（人员）；【财】证券；【法】担保，保证；证券，抵押品
words.example: The school installed cameras to improve security around the campus.

words.zh: n. 犯罪活动；罪行；违反道德的行为，罪过；  v. 判定犯罪；处罚军事犯
words.example: A cyber attack is a serious crime that can harm many people.

words.zh: v. 混合，联合；（使）结合；组合；兼具；同时做（两种活动）；  n. 联合体，联合企业；联合收割机（读作/ˈkɑmˌbaɪn/）
words.example: The lab experiment aims to combine two chemicals safely.

words.zh: adj. 人造的；人为的；假装的，虚伪的；人工的；假的；【财】人造的，假的，虚伪的；  n. 人造肥料
words.example: The park features an artificial lake for boating and fishing.

words.zh: phr. 人工智能
words.example: Doctors use artificial intelligence to diagnose diseases more quickly.

words.zh: v. 克隆；复制；以无性繁殖技术复制；【计】克隆；  n. 克隆；无性繁殖系个体；复制品；克隆动物(或植物)
words.example: Scientists hope to clone the endangered species to prevent its extinction.

words.zh: v. 预言，预告，预测；预料；【化】预测
words.example: It is difficult to predict exactly how technology will change our lives.

words.zh: n. 预测，预言；【数】预测；【计】预测
words.example: Her prediction about the robot's popularity proved surprisingly accurate.

words.zh: n. 预报；预言；预测；  v. 预报；预测
words.example: The weather forecast says it will rain all weekend, so bring an umbrella.

words.zh: n. 占领，占据；占用，居住；职业，工作；消遣
words.example: She listed her occupation as a graphic designer on the city registration form.

words.zh: v. 反对；反抗；抵制；【化】阻挠，反对；  vt. 阻挠
words.example: Many local residents oppose the plan to build a factory near the school.

words.zh: adv. 因此；由此；  int. <诗>去
words.example: The temperature dropped suddenly, hence we postponed the outdoor experiment.

words.zh: v. 停止，结束；终止；  n. 停止，停息
words.example: The factory must cease operations until it meets the new safety standards.

words.zh: adj. 死去的，死去了的；亡故的
words.example: The museum displayed the deceased artist's final unfinished painting.

words.zh: n. 不在，缺席；缺乏
words.example: The teacher noticed his absence from class and called his parents.

words.zh: adj. 乡村的，田园的；农村的
words.example: Many young people move from rural villages to cities in search of better jobs.

words.zh: vt. 提倡；支持；拥护 n. 提倡者；支持者；拥护者
words.example: Some scientists advocate using renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions.

words.zh: n. 强调；重点；重要性；重视
words.example: The school places great emphasis on developing students' critical thinking skills.

words.zh: adj. 奢侈的，豪华的；  n. 奢侈，奢华；奢侈品
words.example: After the long hike, a hot shower felt like a true luxury.

words.zh: phr. （与……）保持联系；了解
words.example: We promised to keep in touch after graduating from high school.

words.zh: n. 职业，事业；生涯，经历；  vi. 全速前进，猛冲；  vt. 在……中急行
words.example: She hopes her internship will lead to a rewarding career in journalism.

words.zh: n. 前景，展望；视野；可能性；景象（读作/ˈprɑˌspɛk(t)/）；希望；  v. 勘察；有前途；勘探；对……进行仔细调查（读作/ˈprɑːspekt/）
words.example: The prospect of studying abroad excites many high school students.

words.zh: v. 抗拒；抵抗，抵制；反抗；抵挡；耐得住；使不受…的伤害；抗（伤害）
words.example: It is hard to resist the temptation to check your phone while studying.

words.zh: n. 阻力；抵抗；抵制；抵抗力；电阻；反对；【物】电阻
words.example: Regular exercise can increase your body's resistance to common illnesses.

words.zh: n. （文章的）段，节
words.example: Please write one paragraph summarizing the main argument of the article.

words.zh: n. 路标；  v. 设置路标
words.example: The wooden signpost at the trailhead showed the way to the waterfall.

words.zh: n. 文章，短文；论文；尝试；随笔；  v. 尝试
words.example: The teacher asked us to write a five-paragraph essay about climate change.

words.zh: adj. 正确的，符合标准的；准确的；精密的；精确的；正确无误的；【化】精确的，准确的；【物】准确的
words.example: To get accurate results, follow the experiment instructions exactly.

words.zh: n. 图书管理员
words.example: The librarian helped me locate several books for my research project.
